title: Website Business Analyzer input
description: Analyze one public business website. The crawler is bounded, same-domain by default, and SSRF protected.

websiteUrl.title: Website URL
websiteUrl.description: Public http(s) website URL, for example https://example.com

maxDepth.title: Maximum link depth
maxDepth.description: Maximum number of internal link hops from the homepage (0–5).

includeBusinessAnalysis.title: Business analysis
includeBusinessAnalysis.description: Extract company, business model, products, and services.

includeTechnology.title: Technology detection
includeTechnology.description: Detect technologies from public HTML, scripts, headers, and metadata.

includeSEO.title: SEO signals
includeSEO.description: Analyze measurable on-page SEO and indexability signals.

includeSalesIntelligence.title: Sales intelligence
includeSalesIntelligence.description: Generate evidence-based sales, marketing, and automation opportunities.

includeContacts.title: Contacts
includeContacts.description: Extract publicly displayed business emails, phones, addresses, and contact page.

includeSocialProfiles.title: Social profiles
includeSocialProfiles.description: Detect public links to major social and developer profiles.

includePricing.title: Pricing intelligence
includePricing.description: Detect pricing pages, plans, prices, trials, and contact-for-pricing signals.

includeOpportunities.title: Opportunities
includeOpportunities.description: Return prioritized, evidence-based website improvement opportunities.

sameDomainOnly.title: Same domain only
sameDomainOnly.description: Do not follow links or redirects to another hostname.

language.title: Content language
language.description: Language hint for the website content; auto is recommended.
